newsitem.title: USA: Braun's Fashions May same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Braun's Fashions May same store sales up.

text.p: Braun's Fashions Corp said THursday its comparable store sales for the four weeks ended May 31, 1997 rose eight percent from the same period last year.
Braun's, a specialty retailer, also said its fiscal first quarter comparable store sales increased 19 percent from a year ago. Total sales for the quarter were $21.8 million.

"I am particularly pleased with the eight percent comp store increase for the month of May given the unseasonably cold weather in the upper Midwest where we have the majority of our stores," said Nicholas Cook, chairman and chief executive officer.
"Our few stores in the southern and western regions, where weather patterns were normal, enjoyed strong double digit sales increases," he said in a statement.
"Our inventories are current and on plan and we look forward to a continuation of the strong sales momentum we have established over the last three quarters," he said.
Braun's operates 170 stores in 20 states, primarily in the Midwest and Pacific Northwest.
